title: Levitt Pavilion Denver

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Thank you for your interest in permitting the Levitt Pavilion Denver for your event. Please fill out the application below and then click the submit button. Our staff will be in touch with you with-in 24 hours or your submittal to let you know if the requested date is available. If the requested date is available the applicant will need to sign a waiver before the final application is processed and the permit is issued. Sign up with your email address to receive news and updates about Levitt Pavilion

services.name: Yoga on the Lawn
services.desc: Join us in the spirit of promoting free mental and physical wellness to our community as we team up with Levitt Pavilion Denver. Revive Bodywork yoga instructor, Jessica Shores, will be leading an all-levels vinyasa yoga class from 9:00a - 10:00a. Classes are free to attend and encouraged for people of all skill

services.name: Early Entry
services.desc: Doors for members open 30 minutes before GA doors, allowing first entry into the venue.Please note that doors may potentially be pushed back due to weather or production issues, though we do everything in our power to stay on

blurb: Levitt Pavilion Denver is Colorado’s all-ages outdoor amphitheater, presenting 50 FREE + concerts and community events each summer in beautiful Ruby Hill Park. We believe that music has the power to bring people together across cultures, languages and lived experiences and should be accessible to everyone - regardless of their ability to pay.
